title: Name configuration version skew instead of a raw validator error
goal: The dashboard and doctor say when the running service is older than its configuration or its checkout
acceptance: Test committed failing first: a config field from a newer NERV gives a message naming the cause, not `Unsupported updatePolicy field`; a field no version knows is still rejected
`nerv doctor` reports a running revision different from the checkout HEAD
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: a known-fields registry by version and one doctor check. Not a measurement.
